label: Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 Hits
delta: 'SWIM' in 10th consecutive week on Hot 100 (No. 55, chart dated May 30); 7th No. 1 on Billboard Global Excl. US in 2026 (3 consecutive weeks). Drake's 'Janice STFU' displaced SWIM to No. 10 on Global 200. All 13 ARIRANG vocal tracks on global charts for 9th straight week.

delta: ARIRANG held 3 consecutive #1 weeks (K-pop first); now 9 consecutive charting weeks in total — longest sustained K-pop run in Billboard 200 history. ARIRANG at No. 8 Billboard 200 (chart ~May 25). All 13 vocal tracks remain active on global charts.
